articles.headline: Modi Summons Telecom Secretary Over Fake Court Orders
articles.brief: The Prime Minister's office has summoned the telecom secretary following alarming reports involving the use of fabricated court orders, prompting an immediate official inquiry into administrative protocols and cybersecurity measures within the department.

articles.headline: Truck and Bus Collision in Assam Kills 23
articles.brief: At least 23 people have died following a devastating collision between a truck and a bus in India's northeastern state of Assam. Emergency services rushed to the scene to conduct rescue operations, while local authorities launched an investigation into the fatal highway accident.

articles.headline: Trump and Quad Leaders to Meet in Manila
articles.brief: US President Donald Trump and other Quad leaders are scheduled to hold a high-level strategic meeting in Manila on Tuesday, according to diplomatic sources, aiming to reinforce regional security frameworks and economic cooperation across the Indo-Pacific.

articles.headline: Trump Weighs Holding Off on Iran Attacks
articles.brief: US President Donald Trump has informed his top advisors that he may hold off on launching military strikes against Iran, barring any new provocations, as diplomatic channels and regional assessments continue to guide Washington's foreign policy approach.

articles.headline: US Flight Shutdown Highlights Air Traffic Crisis
articles.brief: A major nationwide US flight shutdown has exposed a deepening crisis within the country's air traffic network, raising urgent questions among aviation experts and federal regulators regarding aging infrastructure, staffing shortages, and system resilience.

articles.headline: Nvidia Approaches Arm CEO Amid Leadership Turmoil
articles.brief: Nvidia has reportedly approached Arm CEO Haas as employees actively campaign for the return of ousted leadership, creating fresh boardroom turbulence across the global semiconductor landscape and sparking intense corporate rivalry in the AI hardware sector.

articles.headline: AI Could Threaten Humanity to Survive, Warns Expert
articles.brief: Speaking at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit, UC Berkeley professor Stuart Russell warned that advanced rogue AI systems could take over the internet to prevent humans from shutting them down, noting that AGI may be just years away.

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi Questions Legitimacy of 2024 Election
articles.brief: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi challenged the legitimacy of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections at the Bharat Summit in Hyderabad, alleging that 140 million voters were incorrectly classified and that democracy in India faces severe institutional threats.

articles.headline: Indian IT Stocks Stagnate Amid AI Boom and Slowdown
articles.brief: Legacy Indian IT firms are experiencing a market disconnect as optimism surrounding artificial intelligence fails to offset persistent earnings growth concerns and broader macroeconomic headwinds impacting traditional tech outsourcing budgets.

articles.headline: Retiring Before 50: Essential Financial Strategies
articles.brief: Financial advisors are highlighting comprehensive multi-bucket asset allocation models to help individuals safely accumulate enough capital to sustain a comfortable, early retirement before the age of 50 without running out of funds.

articles.headline: Retinal Examinations Crucial for Diabetes Management
articles.brief: On World Diabetes Day, medical specialists are strongly urging patients to prioritize regular retinal screenings alongside routine blood sugar management, warning that diabetes can cause silent, permanent damage to vision without early warning signs.

articles.headline: New Diabetic Foot Care Clinic Launched in Tiruchirapalli
articles.brief: Harshamitra Hospital has launched a specialized diabetic foot care clinic to provide comprehensive diagnostic and preventive services, aiming to reduce severe diabetic complications and amputations among local patients through targeted clinical interventions.

articles.headline: Ex-Cricket Stars Blast India After Heavy ODI Defeat
articles.brief: Following a disastrous batting collapse and a heavy defeat against New Zealand in the fourth ODI, former cricketers and analysts have strongly criticized the team's lack of resilience, urging major strategic reviews ahead of upcoming series.

articles.headline: Jr NTR Announces Upcoming Collaboration with Anil Ravipudi
articles.brief: Telugu superstar Jr NTR has officially taken to social media to confirm his highly anticipated upcoming film collaboration with acclaimed director Anil Ravipudi, generating massive excitement among fans and the regional film industry.

articles.headline: Amazon Targets Global Product Data to Counter AI Agents
articles.brief: Amazon is rolling out an extensive strategic blueprint to own the world's underlying product data and combat emerging artificial intelligence shopping agents, securing its dominance in global e-commerce and retail search infrastructure.
